# Citation

Inline numbered citation marker.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Citation`

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Citation n={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Citation" n="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Inline numbered citation marker. Links to the source when `href` is set.

## Props (CitationProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `n` * | `number` | The source number, matching its place in `sources`. |
| `href` | `string` |  |
| `title` | `string` | Source title, used for the tooltip and accessible name. |
